test_title: PYST 31: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Falter
solution: The correct answer is: **Stabilise**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Falter **means to hesitate or waver in action, speech, or purpose. (कार्य, भाषण या उद्देश्य में झिझकना या डगमगाना) • **Example**: *His confidence began to falter.* • Marked option **Stabilise **means to make something stable or steady. (किसी चीज़ को स्थिर या स्थिर बनाना) • **Example**: *The economy started to stabilize.* • An antonym is a word that has the opposite meaning to the given word. • Therefore, Stabilise is the most appropriate antonym of Falter. Thus, **option 1** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Suspect **means to have doubts or mistrust about someone or something. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु के बारे में संदेह या अविश्वास होना) • **Haunt **means to continually disturb or distress someone. (किसी को लगातार परेशान या परेशान करना) • **Transfer **means to move from one place to another. (एक स्थान से दूसरे स्थान पर जाना) 36:Tb72, The correct answer is: **Damage**.
